title: Zesty Comforting Irish Beef Brisket Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew featuring beef brisket, with a zesty twist from fresh herbs, and a snappy texture from air-fried elements, all while being diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef brisket pieces with salt and black pepper.
Air-fry the beef brisket pieces for 10 minutes to achieve a crispy exterior.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, fresh thyme, and fresh rosemary to the pot, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the air-fried beef brisket, beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
